第十九章 连续突破！
上当了！
这是秦易的第一反应，身形唰的一下，折返回来，脸色阴沉得可怕，好像能拧出水一般，体内的玄气狂暴且恐怖，震得身后刚站起来的秦开秦和二人险些又瘫倒。
“混蛋，秦轩，你逃不掉的！就算你逃得再远，本公子也一定会把你抓出来，千刀万剐！”声浪滔滔，震耳欲聋，充满了愤怒，秦易只感觉脸上火辣辣的，这还是他生平第一次被人耍得团团转，如何能不怒？
耻辱啊！
“你们两个，愣着干吗？还不追！”
“可，可是大哥，那个方向是火焰山脉的内围啊，恐怕……”秦开小声说道，声音充满了畏惧，生怕激怒眼前这位大哥。
“哼！两个废物！”瞥了眼站都站不稳的秦开二人，秦易冷喝一声，随即不再理会，身形拔高，化作一道流光，朝着少年逃走的方向追去。
秦开秦和兄弟二人对视一眼，皆是发现彼此眼中的屈辱和愤怒，随即也是无奈的跟了上去。
二人知道，以秦易的性格，如果此时他们独自离开的话，以后在秦家，怕是都没好日子过了。
火焰山脉的内围其实与外围并无太大的差别，只不过周围的植物比外围更加的粗壮罢了，此时，一道黑色的身影快速的从眼前闪过，速度之快，眨眼间便消失在视线内。
这道黑影自然便是秦轩，此时的他显得气息有些不稳，身上不时的溢出一股诡异的气势，时而阴冷，时而灼热，充满了毁灭性，周围一些魔兽见此连忙避开。
足足前行了半个时辰，秦轩这才停了下来，一脸凝重，盘膝坐于一空地上，深吸一口凉气，双眼渐渐闭了起来。
吞噬魔核，秦轩并非意气用事，没有经过大脑思考。
事实上，秦易实在太强了，远非他能相比的，气海境强者的强大，远非他的想象，在气机被锁定的情况下，如果不选择吞噬魔核，恐怕连逃跑的机会都没有。
而他也想过，既然‘英雄神典’连重宝都能炼化吸收，那么，应该也能吸收魔核才是。
当然，这一切不过是猜测罢了。
但是现在，从如今体内的情况分析，这个猜测得到了完美的证实。
也正因为如此，所以，这才有了秦轩看似疯狂的举动，不仅吓退了秦易，还挖掘出了‘英雄神典’另一个作用。
至于为何秦轩不趁此机会逃出火焰山脉，反而深入内围，自然也有他的原因。

在靠近火焰山脉内围时，他便隐约感受到有一道声音正在召唤着他，虽然这股召唤很飘渺，甚至有些不真实，但是越是深入，秦轩就感觉这股召唤越强。
不再多想，体内的玄气缓慢转动起来，利用‘英雄神典’，秦轩开始慢慢炼化体内的那颗黑齿豹魔核，随着一个简单的命令，原本包裹着魔核的万千红色丝线顿时化为一柄柄利刃，将魔核分割无数。
这一下，顿时如火山爆发，一股异常灼热的感觉袭来，秦轩只觉得体内顿时充满了熔浆热流一般，甚至能闻到一丝硫磺的味道，而从外面看，只见其皮肤忽的通红无比，忽的晶莹剔透，连体内的经络器官都能看得一清二楚。
一股黑色的气流自其脚下萦绕而上。
这时，一股强绝的玄气猛的自少年身上冲天而起，直入云霄，仿若魔神降临，原本晴朗的天空顿时暗了下来，似乎连神灵都畏惧了一般。
在他的头顶，一本金黄色书籍渐渐显现，仿若来自洪荒，充满了古老和神秘，神圣异常，正是‘英雄神典’虚影，而在虚影正上方，一道巨大的竖眼盯着下方的黑衣少年，眼神冰冷，不带丝毫感情，令人畏惧。
接着，一股至强至圣的能量朝四面八方扩散而去，整个火焰山脉顿时静了下来，所有的魔兽在这股气息下匍匐在地，瑟瑟发抖，不敢有丝毫动弹。
巨大竖眼突然涌出一道红色能量，疯狂的注入少年的天灵盖，看上去，就如一道红色的瀑布倾洒而下，没入少年体内，壮观之极，宏伟之极。
自少年的体内，兀的响起一道类似蛋壳破裂的声音，仿若破茧重生，随后，一股浑厚的玄气萦绕而起，源源不绝，令人心悸，而在其头顶上方的两道虚影而渐渐的消去，化为虚无。
猛的睁开双眼，秦轩的眼中闪过一抹诡异的黑芒，站了起来，筋骨传来一阵音爆，随后大喝一声，右拳猛的挥出，气势刚猛，勇往直前，如战神临世。
只见三米开外，一株两人合抱的大树轰然倒下，而在树干上，赫然有着一个清晰的拳印。
“炼体九重！”
嘴角微微一翘，秦轩心中满是兴奋，万万没想到会因祸得福，一举成功踏入炼体九重的境界，离气海境也仅差一步之遥。
“如今即使在面对秦易，我也无所畏惧了！”感受着体内雄厚的玄气，秦轩信心满满，虽说他刚踏入炼体九重，但不知为何，他总感觉，即使面对气海境强者，他也有一战之力。
再者，自己踏入了炼体九重，盖伦也应该成功踏入气海境了。
“嗯？”
突然，一道讯息传入秦轩的脑海内，闭眼微微感受一番，等重新睁开双眼时，眼中一片清明，困恼心中许久的疑惑瞬间烟消云散。
“果然如此。”
从脑海中的讯息显示，以后自己若想召唤新的英雄，除了等级够了之外，还要给‘英雄神典’提供重宝吸收，或者利用魔核，当然，这里指的魔核是高阶魔核。
如之前在炼体六重的时候，自己之所以迟迟无法突破，甚至经脉无法修复，就是因为没有给‘英雄神典’充能了。

简单点来说，重宝，魔核，这就是秦轩目前实力的来源。
“连晋三重，经脉也开始自动修复了。”满意的点了点头，随后秦轩便觉得有些无奈，虽说他进步惊人，但是消耗也同样惊人，先不说重宝，单是那可黑齿豹的魔核，若放在市场上，至少达到十万金币！
十万金币，足足是一个小家族一年的收入啊！
“呼。”
轻呼出一口浊气，秦轩也不再多想，看了眼四周的景象，自己显然已经踏入了火焰山脉内围，而且还是中心地带！
周围静悄悄，甚至连他自己的呼吸声能清晰可闻。
脑海中那股召唤越来越强烈，秦轩皱了皱眉，没有丝毫迟疑，灵器‘黑铁’大剑紧紧握着，然后朝着一个方向踏步而去。
火焰山脉内围危机重重，死者无数，谁也不知道会发生什么事情，由不得他不小心……

Chapter 19 Continuous breakthroughs!
Fooled!
This was Qin Yi's first reaction. He swung his body and turned back, his face was so gloomy that he could squeeze out water. The profound energy in his body was violent and terrifying, so shocked that Qin Kai, Qin He and the two who had just stood up behind him almost collapsed again.
"Asshole, Qin Xuan, you can't escape! No matter how far you escape, I will definitely catch you and cut you to pieces!" The sound was roaring, deafening, and full of anger. Qin Yi felt his face burning. This was the first time in his life that he was fooled around. How could he not be angry?
Shame!
"You two, what are you doing standing around here? Why don't you give chase?"
"But, brother, that direction is the inner perimeter of the Flame Mountain Range. I'm afraid..." Qin Kai whispered, his voice full of fear, for fear of angering the big brother in front of him.
"Hmph! Two losers!" Glancing at Qin Kai and the other two who were unable to stand still, Qin Yi shouted coldly, then ignored them, raised his figure, turned into a stream of light, and chased in the direction where the young man escaped.
Qin Kaiqin and his two brothers looked at each other, noticing the humiliation and anger in each other's eyes, and then followed helplessly.
The two knew that with Qin Yi's character, if they left alone at this time, they might not have a good life in the Qin family in the future.
The inner perimeter of the Flame Mountain Range is actually not much different from the outer perimeter, except that the surrounding plants are thicker than the outer perimeter. At this time, a black figure quickly flashed past the eyes, so fast that it disappeared from sight in the blink of an eye.
This black shadow was naturally Qin Xuan. At this time, his aura seemed a little unstable, and a strange aura overflowed from his body from time to time. Sometimes it was cold, sometimes it was hot, and it was full of destructiveness. Some monsters around him quickly avoided seeing this.
After walking forward for half an hour, Qin Xuan stopped, with a solemn expression on his face. He sat cross-legged on the ground, took a deep breath, and gradually closed his eyes.
When Qin Xuan devoured the demonic core, he didn't act on impulse or think through his brain.
In fact, Qin Yi was too strong, far beyond what he could compare with. The power of the Qi Sea Realm expert was far beyond his imagination. When the Qi machine was locked, if he did not choose to swallow the magic core, he might not even have a chance to escape.
And he also thought that since the 'Divine Heroes' can refine and absorb even heavy treasures, it should also be able to absorb magic cores.
Of course, this is all just speculation.
But now, based on the analysis of the current situation in the body, this guess has been perfectly confirmed.
It is precisely because of this that Qin Xuan's seemingly crazy behavior not only scared off Qin Yi, but also discovered another function of the 'Hero Divine Code'.
As for why Qin Xuan did not take this opportunity to escape from the Flame Mountains, but instead went deep into the inner siege, he naturally had his reasons.
As he approached the inner perimeter of the Flame Mountains, he vaguely felt a voice calling him. Although the call was ethereal and even unreal, the deeper he went, the stronger Qin Xuan felt.
No longer thinking about it, the profound energy in his body started to rotate slowly. Using the 'Divine Code of Heroes', Qin Xuan began to slowly refine the black-toothed leopard magic core in his body. With a simple command, the thousands of red silk threads that originally wrapped the magic core suddenly turned into a sharp blade, dividing the magic core into countless pieces.
This time, it was like a volcano erupting, and an unusually hot feeling came over him. Qin Xuan felt that his body was suddenly filled with molten heat, and he could even smell a hint of sulfur. From the outside, his skin suddenly became extremely red, and suddenly became crystal clear, and even the meridians and organs in his body could be clearly seen.
A black air flow lingered up from his feet.
At this time, a powerful mysterious energy suddenly rose from the young man's body and went straight into the sky. It was like a demon coming, and the originally clear sky suddenly darkened, as if even the gods were afraid.
Above his head, a bookThe golden book gradually appeared, as if it came from the ancient times, full of antiquity, mystery, and sacred anomalies. It was the phantom of the 'Hero Divine Code'. And directly above the phantom, a huge vertical eye stared at the black-clothed young man below. The eyes were cold, devoid of any emotion, and terrifying.
Then, a powerful and holy energy spread in all directions, and the entire Flame Mountain suddenly became silent. All the magical beasts prostrated on the ground under this breath, trembling, and did not dare to move at all.
A burst of red energy suddenly surged out of the huge vertical eye and crazily poured into the boy's Tianling Cap. It looked like a red waterfall pouring down and submerging into the boy's body. It was extremely spectacular and majestic.
From the young man's body, a sound similar to the cracking of an eggshell suddenly sounded, as if breaking out of a cocoon and being reborn. Then, a thick mysterious energy lingered in an endless stream, which was heart-stopping. The two shadows above his head gradually disappeared and turned into nothingness.
Opening his eyes suddenly, Qin Xuan's eyes flashed with a strange black light. He stood up, a sonic boom came from his muscles and bones, and then he shouted loudly and swung out his right fist fiercely, moving forward bravely, like the God of War coming to the world.
Three meters away, a big tree with two people hugging each other suddenly fell down, and there was a clear fist mark on the trunk.
"Ninth level of body refining!"
The corner of his mouth curled up slightly. Qin Xuan was filled with excitement. He never expected that he would be a blessing in disguise. He successfully entered the ninth level of body refining and was only one step away from the Qi Sea realm.
"Now, even if I face Qin Yi, I have nothing to fear!" Feeling the strong profound energy in his body, Qin Xuan was full of confidence. Although he had just entered the ninth level of body refining, for some reason, he always felt that he was still capable of fighting even against a strong person in the Qi Sea Realm.
Furthermore, since he has entered the ninth level of body refining, Galen should also have successfully entered the Qi Sea realm.
"Huh?"
Suddenly, a message came into Qin Xuan's mind. He closed his eyes and felt it for a while. When he opened his eyes again, his eyes were clear and the long-standing doubts in his heart disappeared instantly.
"As expected."
The information in my mind shows that if I want to summon new heroes in the future, in addition to being of sufficient level, I must also provide the 'Hero Dictionary' with heavy treasures to absorb, or use magic cores. Of course, the magic cores I refer to here are high-level magic cores.
For example, when I was at the sixth level of body refining before, the reason why I couldn't break through and even couldn't repair my meridians was because I didn't charge the 'Hero Divination'.
To put it simply, heavy treasure and magic core are the source of Qin Xuan's current strength.
"Even at the third level of the Jin Dynasty, the meridians have begun to repair automatically." Qin Xuan nodded with satisfaction, and then felt a little helpless. Although his progress was amazing, the consumption was equally astonishing. Not to mention the heavy treasures, the black-toothed leopard's magic core alone, if placed on the market, would cost at least one hundred thousand gold coins!
One hundred thousand gold coins is enough for a small family to make a year's income!
"Huh."
Qin Xuan let out a breath of turbid air and stopped thinking about it. He looked at the scene around him and saw that he had obviously entered the inner area of the Flame Mountain Range, and it was still in the center!
It was so quiet that even his own breathing could be heard clearly.
The summons in his mind became stronger and stronger. Qin Xuan frowned. Without any hesitation, he held the spiritual weapon 'Black Iron' sword tightly, and then stepped away in one direction.
There are many dangers in the Flame Mountains, and there are countless dead people. No one knows what will happen, so he cannot help but be careful...
